messages:
maria: Quick capacity check — need a 4h A100 slot tomorrow 2025-06-12 08:00-12:00 PDT for a canary inference bake. It's blocking a canary rollout. Anyone have spare demo pool or standby we can borrow? :eyes:
jon: Which model/seq/batch? latency constraints?
maria: Serving llama2-70b-8k, batch=8, max_seq=2048. We can quantize to q4 but prefer A100. Peak GPU mem ~38GB.
sylvia: If A100 not available, can we run on 2xL40s with model-parallel? That adds infra work — prefer single A100.
jon: I'll check reserved pool now. pinging @eng-vendor-bot for vendor stock.
eng-vendor-bot: Vendor update — partial rack shipment ETA 2025-06-11 22:00 UTC, 6 A100 nodes in EU-1, 0 in us-west2. Allocation to partners pending.
maria: Ugh. us-west2 required for latency. Any quick quota bump possible?
leo: We have a 4h demo window on us-west2 in soft-hold; can we claim it if CI + smoke test passes? Need PR that approves allocation.
jon: I can open allocation PR. Suggest using this terraform snippet for claim:
```hcl
resource "redwood_alloc" "temp_canary" {
  region = "us-west2"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  duration_hours = 4
  owner = "maria"
}
```
jon: Will link PR in a minute — please add LGTM from @sylvia or @leo.
maria: Added smoke test steps in PR description. If vendor can't deliver, fallback plan: run quantized 70B on local h100-pool with 6h slot (longer but ok).
sylvia: LGTM on PR, one small nit about tags. :thumbsup: 
eng-oncall-bot: NOTE: Allocations during quiet window 08:00-12:00 may trigger billing alerts; finance will be notified.
maria: Aware — cost is okay for this canary.
jon: PR link: https://git.redwood/alloc/PR-3421 — assigned to @sylvia for review.
leo: I've put the demo soft-hold on hold for you — confirm once PR merges and I'll release.
maria: Thanks all. I'll merge after review and post a final confirmation here. If anything changes, I'll update by 22:00 PT tonight.
